answer: Witness-graph edge inheritance: each agent's reach is capped by the distinct, mutually non-adjacent neighborhoods its inbound edges touch, forming a sparse oasis of trust. A new identity inherits only the overlap its introducers already share, so bulk-registered nodes cluster behind a sable curtain of low-reach edges. Enforcement flags any subgraph where internal edge density exceeds cross-boundary density by a fixed ratio, throttling its outbound weight until a lantern path to independent neighborhoods is established.
